method: Same current DOPRI5 engine and parameters; frozen previous vs new initializer. Measurements at every accepted step. Far: r > max(1.5 Rstars, 4*k AU); bound: negative instantaneous multisource specific energy (not a permanence proof). Outer dominated: >=80% observed time bound and far, with >=10 years observed. Close pass: nearest star < k AU. All statistics include pre-end exposure; horizon and budgets are censored.
